<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version=" 1.0 " datamodel=" ecmascript " initial=" idle ">
  <datamodel>
    <data id=" count " expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id=" idle ">
    <onentry>
      <send event=" tick " id=" timer " delay="1s"/>
      <cancel sendid=" timer "/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event=" go  stop " cond="In('idle') && count === 0" target=" done " type=" internal "/>
  </state>
  <final id=" done "/>
</scxml>
